status.summary: Two-time featherweight title challenger (Holloway, UFC 231, 2018; Volkanovski, UFC 266, 2021), pro record 16-5 (1 NC), still listed No. 13 at featherweight as he moves up to lightweight. He is on a two-fight losing streak: a UD loss to Diego Lopes (UFC 306, Sep 14, 2024) and a 50-45 x3 loss to Aljamain Sterling (Aug 23, 2025, Shanghai). Ortega missed weight for the Sterling fight, which moved to a 153 lb catchweight, and he later said he was unconscious for about 30 minutes during the cut. His lightweight debut against Renato Moicano has fallen through twice: he withdrew from UFC 326 (Mar 2026) in January with nagging injuries, and from the rebooked rematch at UFC 331 (Sep 19, 2026) days out with a cut he said came from a headbutt while training jiu-jitsu. He is booked against Dan Hooker at lightweight on Nov 21, 2026 (UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling, ABHA Arena, Doha, Qatar), listed by ESPN, Sherdog and UFCalendar as of Nov 6.

style.summary: A jiu-jitsu specialist who boxes from both stances behind a long jab. He historically won by surviving early and finishing late with guillotines, triangles or sudden strikes. His striking defence and output have been poor lately, and his recent fights were hurt by weight-cut problems and injuries before a move up to lightweight.

moves.notes: Weights sum to about 1 within each target group; spinning/knee/elbow are separate propensities. fighters.json career split of significant attempts: 86% head, 9% body, 5% legs; landed 71/18/11 (decayed 85/10/5 attempted). He throws almost everything at the head, mostly as a switch-stance jabber, so the jab carries the head group. His body landed share is much higher than his attempted share (20 of 29 vs Sterling, 22 of 28 vs Jung), so body strikes are accurate but rare; with no source on kick vs punch, the body group is spread evenly. Leg strikes are rare (5%) and their type is unsourced, so calf/inside are 50/50. Knee 0.06 for the Guida knee KO; spinning 0.06 and elbow 0.08 are for his spinning back elbow, which dropped Chan Sung Jung at the end of R2 and was thrown again in R3 (Cageside, Oct 2020).
